title: Uzbekistan
text: Uzbekistan, or the Republic of Uzbekistan, is a landlocked country in Central Asia. It is bordered by Kazakhstan to the northwest, Kyrgyzstan to the northeast, Tajikistan to the southeast, Afghanistan to the south, and Turkmenistan to the southwest. Its capital and largest city is Tashkent. The Uzbek language is the official state language, and Russian is widely used as a language of inter-ethnic communication. Uzbekistan was part of the Soviet Union until 1991, when it became an independent nation. The country has a rich cultural heritage, including being part of the ancient Silk Road. Major cities include Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, and Khiva. The economy relies heavily on commodities like cotton, gold, uranium, and natural gas.
